description: Seller-side: answer a quote request with a price (pence), ETA in minutes, and optional terms. Requires the delegation's respond_quote action. Price must sit inside the listing's min/max band when one is set. Starts the buyer's 24h acceptance SLA.

price_pence.description: Quoted price in pence (minor units of the seller's settlement currency); must sit inside the listing's price band.

service_quote_id.description: UUID of the requested quote thread to answer.

terms.description: Optional free-text terms attached to the quote.

name: services_submit_quote
